title: Group Distributionally Robust Optimization over Decentralized Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.29261v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study group distributionally robust optimization (GDRO) over decentralized networks, where workers collaborate to learn robust models by minimizing the maximum local risk. Existing methods optimize only dual-regularized surrogates and establish guarantees for a globally averaged model that is not available to workers. In this paper, we directly optimize the original GDRO objective and establish guarantees for local models in semi-decentralized (SemiDec) and fully decentralized (Dec) settings. A key difficulty is that applying the primal-dual decomposition from centralized GDRO yields worker-dependent losses whose evaluation requires unavailable cross-worker information. To address this challenge, we develop a novel error decomposition that recasts decentralized GDRO as (i) a decentralized online convex optimization (D-OCO) problem and a prediction-with-expert-advice problem in SemiDec, and as (ii) two coupled D-OCO problems in Dec,

translated_title: 去中心化网络上的群组分布式鲁棒优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了去中心化网络上的群组分布式鲁棒优化（GDRO），其中各工作节点通过最小化最大局部风险来协作学习鲁棒模型。现有方法仅优化对偶正则化的代理目标，并针对全局平均模型建立理论保证，而该全局平均模型对工作节点来说是不可获取的。在本文中，我们直接优化原始的GDRO目标，并在半去中心化和完全去中心化两种设置下为局部模型建立理论保证。一个关键难点在于，将集中式GDRO中的原始-对偶分解方法应用于此会产生依赖于工作节点的损失函数，而其评估需要无法获取的工作节点间交叉信息。为应对这一挑战，我们开发了一种新颖的误差分解方法，将去中心化GDRO重构为：(i) 在半去中心化设置下的去中心化在线凸优化问题和专家建议预测问题，以及 (ii) 在完全去中心化设置下的两个相互耦合的去中心化在线凸优化问题。
tldr: 该论文提出直接优化去中心化网络上的原始群组分布式鲁棒优化目标，并通过新颖的误差分解方法将其转化为去中心化在线凸优化问题，首次在半去中心化和完全去中心化设置下为工作节点的局部模型建立了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper directly optimizes the original group distributionally robust optimization objective over decentralized networks by developing a novel error decomposition that recasts it as decentralized online convex optimization problems, establishing for the first time theoretical guarantees for local models of workers in both semi-decentralized and fully decentralized settings.
